name: Checkerboard tee
desc: Heavyweight black cotton tee with the Kowloon Tsai checkerboard across the chest and 啟德 underneath.
desc_zh: 厚身黑色棉 T 恤，心口印九龍仔棋盤，下面印「啟德」。

name: IGS 13 approach tee
desc: Off-white tee printed with the approach itself: the 088° IGS course, the 47° right turn at the checkerboard and Runway 13 into the bay.
desc_zh: 米白色 T 恤，印住成個進場：088° IGS 航道、喺棋盤嘅 47° 右轉，同伸入海灣嘅 13 號跑道。

name: Runway 13 cap
desc: Jade-green six-panel cap with the embroidered Fly Kai Tak checkerboard mark on the front.
desc_zh: 翡翠綠六片帽，前面繡上 Fly Kai Tak 棋盤標誌。

name: Kai Tak 1998 patch
desc: Round embroidered patch: the checkerboard and the IGS track, ringed with Runway 13 · Hong Kong 1998.
desc_zh: 圓形刺繡布章：棋盤同 IGS 航跡，外圈寫住 Runway 13 · Hong Kong 1998。

name: Checkerboard enamel pin
desc: Hard enamel pin of the Fly Kai Tak mark: orange-and-white checkerboard crossed by the green turn onto the runway.
desc_zh: Fly Kai Tak 標誌硬琺瑯襟章：橙白棋盤，加一條轉上跑道嘅綠線。

name: Turn right at the checkerboard poster
desc: A jet banking hard right over the checkerboard hill at dusk, with Kowloon City below. Printed on heavy matte stock.
desc_zh: 黃昏時一架客機喺棋盤山前面向右急轉，下面係九龍城。厚身啞面紙印刷。

name: Final approach mug
desc: Enamel camp mug with a checkerboard band and the approach callouts: 088°, 3.1°, turn right.
desc_zh: 琺瑯露營杯，印棋盤帶同進場重點：088°、3.1°、右轉。

name: Sticker sheet
desc: Six vinyl stickers: the checkerboard, a 13-31 runway sign, the 啟德 roundel, a jet in plan view, IGS 088° and a stand number.
desc_zh: 六張乙烯貼紙：棋盤、13-31 跑道牌、啟德圓章、俯視客機、IGS 088° 同停機位號碼。
